name: Akura Saijini
source:
Makoto's long-time friend. She is as opposite of a "proper girl" as it is possible for a young woman to be; she is foul-mouthed, extremely crass, and most notably, loves blasting massive farts in public. In spite of this, she is very caring and has a good sense of humor. 

[spoiler] She figured out Makoto's fart fetish on her own, thanks to her psychology class, and she purposefully farts around him all the time, knowing it turns him on.
